    AI Overview
    Braylon Mullins, a freshman guard for the UConn Huskies (2025-26 season), is the son of Josh and Katie Mullins
    . His father, Josh Mullins, played college basketball at Lincoln Trail College and Indiana University–Purdue University Indianapolis (IUPUI). 
    Key Details About Josh Mullins: 
    • Basketball Background: Played at the collegiate level at IUPUI.
    • Influence: Josh is credited by Braylon for teaching him to be persistent, fighting through challenges, and pushing him to his maximum potential in basketball, according to Instagram posts.
    • Family: Josh and Katie have three sons: Braylon, Cole, and Clay. 
    Note: Braylon Mullins is not related to NBA Hall of Famer Chris Mullin.
